name: Fynnodderee

attributes.attribute: known as the hairy one of the Isle of Man
could not cut his long shaggy hair
kind to humans and helpful as a Brownie

sources: Keightley, Thomas. The Fairy Mythology. London: H. G. Bohn, 1870.
Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The Fynnodderee is a figure from Manx folklore. Folk on Man call him the shaggy figure who roams the island. He loved human women and sought maidens who were not fairies. He missed so many Fairy dances that the Otherworld cast him out. After that he wandered with no settled home. He could not settle down, and he could not cut his long shaggy hair. Yet he stayed kind to people. In his help he could match a Brownie.

okr.objective: The Fynnodderee is the houseless hair-covered being of Manx folklore.
key_results: He is the hairy one of the Isle of Man.
